text:
Paula: Quick update — ran the micro-usability test for the pricing page calc & tier labels. Short summary: users confused by 'Dedicated' vs 'Committed'. leaning toward renaming 'Dedicated' -> 'Reserved Pro' to emphasize commit. Thoughts?

Jon: Curious — any lift in willingness to commit? numbers?

Paula: Small sample (n=40) but net +18% for 'Reserved Pro' vs 'Dedicated' on perceived predictability. engagement with calculator increased 12%. raw notes: users expected billing terms in FAQ, not inline.

Lina: I like 'Reserved Pro' as it hints at reserved capacity. Can we add a hover tooltip that says 'monthly committed capacity'?

Sam: Agree on tooltip. Also we should add an FAQ Q: "What happens if I exceed my committed capacity?" — short answer + link to docs.

Paula: Draft FAQ snippet below — feedback welcome:
```
Q: What is Reserved Pro?
A: Reserved Pro is our committed capacity plan — you reserve GPU capacity for predictable throughput and lower unit cost. Overage is billed at your committed rate + burst pricing; see docs.redwood.ai/reserved-billing for details.
```

Lina: One more Q suggestion: "Can I change my reserved size mid-term?" quick answer: "Yes, via support or console; prorated adjustments."

Jon: For the calculator: let's add a toggle "Include burst credits" and a small footnote about variance ±20% for spikes.

Paula: Added toggle to figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/pricing-calc — updated component names to "Reserved Pro" and "Hosted Standard". Could someone sanity-check copy in the calc modal?

Sam: I'll do a quick pass today. :thumbsup:

Ava-bot: poll results posted in #marketing-ops, 11 votes preferring 'Reserved Pro', 5 for 'Dedicated', 3 for other labels.

Paula: Perfect. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll push the FAQ updates to the staging site and hand off calc dev tickets to eng. tagging @Jon @Lina for final sign-off.
